THE ANATOMY OF A MAGNETIC CLOSURE

Built to
click.

  1. 01

    One quiet click.

    The cap seats on its shoulder collar with a magnetic hold. No thread, no twist.

  2. 02

    Lift, and it lets go.

    A gentle pull releases the magnet and reveals the spray pump beneath.

  3. 03

    Every layer, made to fit.

    Cap, shoulder collar and crimp pump, matched to FEA13 or FEA15 bottle necks.

  4. 04

    Any finish you imagine.

    Glossy, matte, brushed, coated or hardwood. Glossy gold

  5. 05

    Your mark, engraved.

    Laser-carved or screen-printed logos make the cap unmistakably yours.
